evidence_boundary: This is a deterministic, metadata-only whole-system demo. It does not execute production commands, connect to AWS, GitHub, MCP servers, Linux Foundation projects, TRACE runtimes, or customer systems, prove production safety, certify compliance, prove customer demand, or prove incident reduction.
one_line_summary: SMERC takes one proposed high-impact action from identity/context through recoverability scoring, posture, route controls, separate recovery authority, bounded execution, postcondition evidence, and a valid decision lifecycle ledger.

stages.name: Identity / Context
stages.role: Validates actor, session, typed contract, attestation, least privilege, object shape, and required evidence before scoring.

stages.name: Recoverability Engine
stages.role: Scores whether the proposed action is reversible, bounded, observable, and safe enough to proceed.

stages.name: Decision Posture
stages.role: Converts recoverability judgment into the shared SMERC decision language.

stages.name: SPARTa Route Controls
stages.role: Translates posture into execution routing, required controls, and whether the action can execute.

stages.name: Recovery Authority Gate
stages.role: Requires separate authority and fresh recovery evidence before a paused action can continue.

stages.name: Bounded Continuation
stages.role: Re-scores the narrowed continuation action and routes it through constrained execution.

stages.name: Executor / Gateway
stages.role: Executes only the permitted bounded route, using a short-lived action-bound permit.

evidence.notes: Synthetic execution result for lifecycle proof only.

stages.name: Postcondition Evidence
stages.role: Records whether the required controls and execution result can be checked after the route.

stages.name: Decision Lifecycle Ledger
stages.role: Preserves a replayable chain of request, evidence, evaluation, human interaction, execution, outcome, and learning records.
